title: Non-hyperelliptic modular curves of genus 3
summary: A curve $C$ defined over $\mathbb Q$ is modular of level $N$ if there exists a non-constant morphism from $X_1(N)$ onto $C$ defined over $\mathbb Q$ for some positive integer $N$. We provide a sufficient and necessary condition for the existence of a modular non-hyperelliptic curve $C$ of genus $3$ and level $N$ such that $\mathrm{Jac}{(C)}$ is $\mathbb Q$-isogenous to a given three dimensional $\mathbb Q$-quotient of $J_1 (N)$.
